description: Copy a local file from a configured import root into the vault. Destination names are collision-safe by default; source roots, size, destination policy, and dryRun are enforced.

collision.description: Override the configured collision policy for this import.

dryRun.description: Preview the change without applying it: returns the planned action and the exact CLI command.

name.description: Optional destination filename; defaults to the source filename.

sourcePath.description: Absolute local path to the file being imported.

name: file_import
title: Import file into vault
